name: Abjuration
description: Protective magic: wards, blocking, banishing, countering other magic.

name: Enchantment
description: Influencing minds, charming, compelling behavior and emotions.

name: Evocation
description: Channeling raw energy for destructive effects or healing.

name: Illusion
description: Deceiving the senses or mind, phantasms, altered perception.

name: Necromancy
description: Manipulating life and death energies, harming undead, raising the dead.

name: Transmutation
description: Physically altering the properties, form, or matter of creatures and objects.
